projectDescription: A Python CLI tool for building, executing, uploading, and managing 507ex portable executables, with an optional Central Application Repository (CAR) server for remote distribution.
keyFeatures: Execute local or remote .507ex files with hash verification
Auto dependency management via embedded dependfile
Upload executables to CAR server for remote distribution
CAR server with secret-code authentication for secure pulls
Unpack .507ex files to inspect their contents
Install via pip as the fzx2 command
publicApiSurface: POST /push — upload an executable to CAR
POST /pull/<file_id> — download an executable from CAR
